https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.name: Municipal_Address_Feature_Layer
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.title: Municipal Address Feature Layer
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.description:
This is a representation of the civic addresses in the City of Thunder Bay, as a point file. The original sources of data collection were CAD property layers, TBAY-CENTROID-ADDRESS, TBAY-CENTROID-ATR, and TBAY-CENTROID layers. Addresses are now completely managed in GIS. The dataset contains the following:

  • REFNAME (Address type)
  • PCL PIN (Main Property UID)
  • TYPE (Property type)
  • CTB Type (City owned property type)
  • RSN (Address specific property UID)
  • Address Qualifier (Address civic number suffix)
  • Object ID
  • Address
  • Street
  • Row type
  • Complete
  • Root
  • City
  • Province
  • Address number
Data was last updated September 8th, 2026

https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.title: Property Parcel Feature Layer
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.description:
This is a representation of the spatial extent of legal parcels of land within the City of Thunder Bay. The data has been collected from legal plans, sub-division plans and reference plans. The dataset contains the following:

  • PCL Pin (main property parcel UID)
  • Parcel Class (property type - City Owned, regular, etc)
  • CTB Type (City Owned property type)
  • RSN (Address specific property UID)
  • LRO Pin (Land Registry Office's parcel UID)
  • Object ID
  • Hectare
  • Acres
  • Shape Length
  • Shape Area
Data was last updated on January 13, 2026

https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.name: Building_Feature_Layer
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.title: Building Feature Layer
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.description:
This representation of the building footprints support municipal base maps. It also serves as a source for public works, public safety, planning and other agencies that are responsible for the active management of site addresses, facilities, and land use information. Sources of data collection are aerial photography digitization, LiDAR dataset and legal building plans. The dataset contains the following:

  • Property RSN (Building Property UID)
  • ObjectID
  • Shortname
  • Fullname
  • City
  • Building Class
  • Building Type
  • Elevation
  • Status
  • Number of units
  • Shape length
  • Shape Area
Data was last updated September 8th, 2026
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.snippet: This feature layer contains building footprints for the City of Thunder Bay. The data represents the general outline and location of built structures, including residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, and other building types. It is intended for general mapping, analysis, and planning purposes. The dataset is updated continually and reflects the most current information available from the City’s GIS and building permit database. Building geometries are based on aerial imagery and municipal records and may not always represent legal building extents.

https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.name: Heritage_Conservation_District_Feature_Layer
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.title: Heritage Conservation District Feature Layer
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.description:
A Heritage Conservation District is an area where significant heritage resources exist and warrant conservation and protection.  Lands in the vicinity of Waverley Park, from the intersection of High Street and Red River Road, extending along Red River Road and Waverly Street beyond Algoma Street, are designated as the Waverley Park Heritage Conservation District. The sources of data collection are the Waverly Heritage Conservation District Study, and the City of Thunder Bay By-law 65-1988.This dataset contains the following:
  • ObjectID
  • Shape
  • Area ha
  • Area ac
  • Name
  • Shape Length
  • Shape Area
Data was last updated June 17, 2025

https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.name: Heritage_Register_-_City_of_Thunder_Bay.csv
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.title: Heritage Register CSV
https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/cont.description:
This listing is of the properties on the Municipal Heritage Register that are: heritage designated by City of Thunder Bay by-law as per section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act; or listed as per section 27 (2) of the Heritage Act. The source of the data is the Office of the City Clerk - Heritage Advisory Committee. The dataset includes:

  • Building Name
  • Address # (Street #)
  • Street
  • Cira (Approximate Date of Construction)
  • Status on Register(Designated or Listed)
  • Year Added (to the register)
  • By-Law/ Report (Designation By-Law Number or corporate report number of listing)
  • Ownership (City of Thunder Bay, City of Thunder Bay board operated, public agency, private, or other level of government)

The data was last updated on August 22 2022.
